name: player-death-drops
comment: WP-2.5a. The player (id 0) falls 39 blocks onto stone and dies on landing (fall damage 36 through damageEntity). EntityPlayer.onDeath: EntityLiving's, the 0.2 box, motionY 0.1, InventoryPlayer.dropAllItems (main slots in order, then armour) through dropPlayerItemWithRandomChoice(stack, true): an EntityItem at the eyes (posY - 0.3 + getEyeHeight() 0.12, three Math.random() draws in its constructor), pick-up delay 40, two rand draws each for the scatter; no attacker: motionX/Z 0; yOffset 0.1. The run ends at t 55, the last tick before deathTime passes 20 (t 56: EntityPlayer.setEntityDead, no cursor stack to drop, and World.updateEntities drops it from loadedEntityList). Vanilla keeps the dead player in World.playerEntities (only World.setEntityDead removes it, World.java:945; the client's respawn does that), so random ticks and randomDisplayUpdates go on around it; the port's World cannot hold an entity outside loadedEntityList yet (reported, WP-2.5a), and its trace would differ from t 56 on.
